info.title: Skyline.DataMiner.CICD.Tools.RunAutomationScript
info.description: This .NET Tools allows you to start an automation script.

options.name: --debug
options.description: Indicates the tool should write out debug logging.

options.name: --minimum-log-level
options.description: Indicates what the minimum log level should be. Default is Information

commands.name: Local
commands.description: Executes an automationscript on the local agent without input parameters or dummies.

options.name: --check-sets
options.description: Indicates whether gets after sets will be performed. Default value is true.

options.name: --extended-error-info
options.description: Indicates whether extended error info is desired or not. Default value is true.

options.name: --is-synchronous
options.description: Indicates whether this call should wait until the script finishes or return immediately. Default value is true.

options.name: --username
options.description: Username for a DataMiner user with permissions to execute automation scripts. This is optional, the username can also be provided using the 'DATAMINER_DEPLOY_USER' environment variable (unix/win) or using 'DATAMINER_DEPLOY_USER_ENCRYPTED' configured with Skyline.DataMiner.CICD.Tools.WinEncryptedKeys (windows).

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for a DataMiner user with permissions to execute automation scripts. This is optional, the password can also be provided using the 'DATAMINER_DEPLOY_PASSWORD' environment variable (unix/win) or using 'DATAMINER_DEPLOY_PASSWORD_ENCRYPTED' configured with Skyline.DataMiner.CICD.Tools.WinEncryptedKeys (windows).
